comment: The machine v0.1 conformance floor. Accepts carry structural expectations (identity, counts, service start order, granted capability set, and where it matters the folded rationale); rejects carry the fragment the refusal must contain, so a runtime refusing for the wrong reason fails (exemplar gap G8, applied from birth). Three of the accepts are the three profiles a machine can declare: a hosted box, an edge sensor, a touch phone. v0.1 widened 2026-09-12 (OS-4) with the BOARD clause: A9, R33, R34, R35 are the board's own; A1 and A2 carry the defaulted and the declared board. Widened again 2026-09-12 (the NETWORK kind): A10, A11, R36-R40; A2 is the box file with its NETWORK; every accept's counts carry networks. Widened again 2026-09-12 (SLOTS, A/B): A12, R41, R42.

accepts.name: the minimal machine: one MACHINE declaration, defaults stated
accepts.source:
DEFINE MACHINE hello AS (
  PROFILE hosted,
  ARCH x86_64,
  KERNEL linux
) RATIONALE "The smallest declarable machine"

accepts.name: the hosted box: the counter machine of a restaurant, whole -- machines/makeen_box.machine verbatim
accepts.source:
-- makeen_box.machine -- the box behind the counter: server, network and
-- bridge in one. The hosted profile's reference machine (fixture A2 is
-- this file, verbatim) and, since OS-4, the board's truth: a Raspberry
-- Pi 4 Model B, the SD card's second partition as /data, the console on
-- the header pins, the network declared and brought up by PID 1 before
-- any world speaks, and two boot slots: an update is tried once under
-- the watchdog and committed only when every world has started. RestoLean's Makeen thread named the box; this
-- declares it.

DEFINE MACHINE makeen_box AS (
  PROFILE hosted,
  ARCH aarch64,
  KERNEL linux,
  LIBC musl,
  BOARD rpi4,
  CONSOLE "/dev/ttyS1",
  SLOTS "/dev/mmcblk0p1"
) RATIONALE "One box, no shell, no package manager: the declared machine is the system; two slots, so an update is a trial before it is a commitment"

DEFINE CAPABILITY network AS (
  GRANT yes
) RATIONALE "The box is the restaurant's network"

DEFINE CAPABILITY filesystem AS (
  GRANT yes
) RATIONALE "Orders and stock live on the box"

DEFINE CAPABILITY gpio AS (
  GRANT no
) RATIONALE "No pins on the counter box; sensors are edge machines"

DEFINE MOUNT data AS (
  AT "/data",
  FS ext4,
  DEVICE "/dev/mmcblk0p2",
  OPTIONS [rw, noatime]
) RATIONALE "The persistent partition: the SD card's second partition"

DEFINE NETWORK lan AS (
  INTERFACE "eth0",
  ADDRESS "192.168.10.1/24"
) RATIONALE "The box is the network's address; the phones find it here. No gateway: the box is the gateway"

DEFINE SERVICE kds AS (
  RUN ["/stzr", "/app/kds.luau"],
  RESTART never,
  NEEDS [network, filesystem]
) RATIONALE "The kitchen display world (a stand-in that exits; the real world is a daemon, RESTART always)"

DEFINE SERVICE poste AS (
  RUN ["/stzr", "/app/poste.luau"],
  RESTART never,
  AFTER [kds],
  NEEDS [network, filesystem]
) RATIONALE "The counter world (a stand-in that exits; the real world is a daemon, RESTART always)"

accepts.name: the edge sensor: no kernel, no libc, pins and a flash log
accepts.source:
DEFINE MACHINE cold_room_sensor AS (
  PROFILE edge,
  ARCH thumbv7em,
  KERNEL none
) RATIONALE "A thermistor, a log, a radio: the binary is the device"

DEFINE CAPABILITY gpio AS (
  GRANT yes
) RATIONALE "The probe and the LED are pins"

DEFINE CAPABILITY clock AS (
  GRANT yes
) RATIONALE "Readings are timestamped"

DEFINE PIN led AS (
  GPIO 17,
  MODE out
) RATIONALE "Heartbeat"

DEFINE PIN probe AS (
  GPIO 4,
  MODE in
) RATIONALE "The thermistor"

DEFINE MOUNT log AS (
  AT "/log",
  FS littlefs,
  DEVICE "flash0"
) RATIONALE "Power-loss safe, wear-levelled"

DEFINE SERVICE sense AS (
  RUN ["sense"],
  RESTART always,
  NEEDS [gpio, clock]
) RATIONALE "Read, log, sleep"

accepts.name: the touch phone: Android's kernel, the launcher is the pack
accepts.source:
DEFINE MACHINE server_phone AS (
  PROFILE touch,
  ARCH aarch64,
  KERNEL android
) RATIONALE "The device is the job: no app drawer, one pack"

DEFINE CAPABILITY network AS (
  GRANT yes
) RATIONALE "Orders travel"

DEFINE CAPABILITY inference AS (
  GRANT yes
) RATIONALE "A small model on the device, offline"

DEFINE SERVICE launcher AS (
  RUN ["/system/bin/stzr", "/pack/launcher.luau"],
  RESTART always,
  NEEDS [network, inference]
) RATIONALE "The pack's entry surface"

accepts.name: AFTER orders the services; declaration order breaks ties
accepts.source:
DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "order"
DEFINE SERVICE c AS (RUN ["c"], AFTER [a, b]) RATIONALE "third"
DEFINE SERVICE b AS (RUN ["b"], AFTER [a]) RATIONALE "second"
DEFINE SERVICE a AS (RUN ["a"]) RATIONALE "first"

accepts.name: a string may span lines; continuation whitespace folds to one space (C6 3.2)
accepts.source:
DEFINE MACHINE m AS (
  PROFILE hosted,
  ARCH x86_64,
  KERNEL linux
) RATIONALE "One
             two
	three"

accepts.name: CRLF line endings are accepted and never diagnosed
accepts.source:
DEFINE MACHINE m AS (
  PROFILE hosted,
  ARCH x86_64,
  KERNEL linux
) RATIONALE "crlf"
DEFINE SERVICE s AS (
  RUN ["s"]
) RATIONALE "one"

accepts.name: comments anywhere, trailing commas everywhere, an empty list
accepts.source:
-- a comment before anything
DEFINE MACHINE m AS ( -- after a paren
  PROFILE hosted, -- after a clause
  ARCH x86_64,
  KERNEL linux,
) RATIONALE "commas"
DEFINE CAPABILITY clock AS (GRANT yes,) RATIONALE "tick"
DEFINE SERVICE s AS (
  RUN ["s", "--flag",],
  AFTER [],
  NEEDS [clock,],
) RATIONALE "lists"
-- a comment at the end, no newline

accepts.name: a board declared: the Raspberry Pi 4 is an aarch64 board
accepts.source:
DEFINE MACHINE box AS (
  PROFILE hosted,
  ARCH aarch64,
  KERNEL linux,
  BOARD rpi4
) RATIONALE "The commodity board"

accepts.name: a static network with its gateway and dns servers
accepts.source:
DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CAPABILITY network AS (GRANT yes) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NETWORK lan AS (
  INTERFACE "eth0",
  ADDRESS "192.168.10.1/24",
  GATEWAY "192.168.10.254",
  DNS ["1.1.1.1", "9.9.9.9"]
) RATIONALE "The counter's wire"

accepts.name: a dhcp network learns everything else
accepts.source:
DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CAPABILITY network AS (GRANT yes) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NETWORK lan AS (INTERFACE "eth0", ADDRESS dhcp) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NETWORK wifi AS (INTERFACE "wlan0", ADDRESS dhcp) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a board that updates A/B names its boot partition
accepts.source:
DEFINE MACHINE box AS (
  PROFILE hosted,
  ARCH aarch64,
  KERNEL linux,
  BOARD rpi4,
  SLOTS "/dev/mmcblk0p1"
) RATIONALE "Two slots, one committed, the other tried under the watchdog"

rejects.name: the alien verb dies at the top
rejects.source: DROP MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: an alien kind dies after DEFINE
rejects.source: DEFINE ROUTER r AS (PROFILE hosted) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: keywords are case-sensitive: lowercase define is an unknown verb
rejects.source: define MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: RATIONALE is mandatory on every declaration
rejects.source: DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux)

rejects.name: the boot path has no shell: a shell line is unexpressible
rejects.source:
DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE SERVICE s AS (RUN ["/bin/sh", "-c", "stzr kds.luau"]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: RUN is an argv, one word per string, never one command string
rejects.source:
DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE SERVICE s AS (RUN "stzr kds.luau") RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: one namespace: a name declared twice is refused
rejects.source:
DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE SERVICE kds AS (RUN ["a"]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE SERVICE kds AS (RUN ["b"]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: AFTER a service that resolves to nothing is refused at check time
rejects.source:
DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE SERVICE kds AS (RUN ["a"], AFTER [network_up]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: exactly one MACHINE per file
rejects.source:
DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MACHINE n AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: the MACHINE declaration comes first
rejects.source:
DEFINE SERVICE s AS (RUN ["a"]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: the identity surface is structural: ARCH is required
rejects.source: DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: an unknown clause is refused, naming the allowed set
rejects.source: DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux, COLOUR blue) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: double quotes only: a single-quoted string is an alien character
rejects.source: DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE 'x'
rejects.refusal: not part of the machine grammar

rejects.name: a mixed-case word is neither identifier nor keyword
rejects.source: DEFINE MACHINE MakeenBox AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a profile and a kernel that contradict each other
rejects.source: DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE edge, ARCH thumbv7em, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: the capability menu is closed: bluetooth is not a capability
rejects.source:
DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CAPABILITY bluetooth AS (GRANT yes) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: silence is refusal: needing a capability no declaration grants
rejects.source:
DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE SERVICE s AS (RUN ["a"], NEEDS [network]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: needing a capability the machine refuses is refused at check time
rejects.source:
DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CAPABILITY network AS (GRANT no) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE SERVICE s AS (RUN ["a"], NEEDS [network]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: an unterminated string is refused
rejects.source: DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "x

rejects.name: a PIN without the gpio capability granted
rejects.source:
DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE edge, ARCH thumbv7em, KERNEL none) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE PIN led AS (GPIO 17, MODE out) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: AFTER forms a cycle: no order starts it
rejects.source:
DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE SERVICE a AS (RUN ["a"], AFTER [b]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE SERVICE b AS (RUN ["b"], AFTER [a]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: ext4 is not a filesystem of the edge profile
rejects.source:
DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE edge, ARCH thumbv7em, KERNEL none) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MOUNT data AS (AT "/data", FS ext4, DEVICE "mmc0") RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: not a filesystem of the edge profile

rejects.name: GRANT is yes or no, never maybe
rejects.source:
DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CAPABILITY network AS (GRANT maybe) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a mount point is an absolute path
rejects.source:
DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MOUNT data AS (AT "data", FS tmpfs) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: the restart menu is closed
rejects.source:
DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE SERVICE s AS (RUN ["a"], RESTART sometimes) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: RESTART is never, always or on_failure

rejects.name: the touch profile owns no mounts: Android's init does
rejects.source:
DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE touch, ARCH aarch64, KERNEL android) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MOUNT data AS (AT "/data", FS ext4, DEVICE "/dev/block/x") RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a service cannot come after itself
rejects.source:
DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE SERVICE a AS (RUN ["a"], AFTER [a]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: RUN must name a program: an empty argv is refused
rejects.source:
DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE SERVICE a AS (RUN []) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a block filesystem needs a DEVICE
rejects.source:
DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MOUNT data AS (AT "/data", FS ext4) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a clause given twice is refused
rejects.source: DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux, ARCH aarch64) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a libc that contradicts the profile
rejects.source: DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux, LIBC bionic) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: an empty file declares nothing
rejects.source: -- nothing but a comment

rejects.name: a board of another architecture is refused
rejects.source: DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux, BOARD rpi4) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: the board menu is closed
rejects.source: DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH aarch64, KERNEL linux, BOARD banana) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: BOARD is a hosted machine's clause
rejects.source: DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE edge, ARCH thumbv7em, KERNEL none, BOARD rpi4) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: silence is refusal: a NETWORK without the network capability granted
rejects.source:
DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NETWORK lan AS (INTERFACE "eth0", ADDRESS dhcp) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a dhcp network learns its gateway: GATEWAY is refused
rejects.source:
DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CAPABILITY network AS (GRANT yes) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NETWORK lan AS (INTERFACE "eth0", ADDRESS dhcp, GATEWAY "10.0.0.1") RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: an address without its prefix is refused at check time
rejects.source:
DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CAPABILITY network AS (GRANT yes) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NETWORK lan AS (INTERFACE "eth0", ADDRESS "192.168.10.1") RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: one network per interface
rejects.source:
DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CAPABILITY network AS (GRANT yes) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NETWORK a AS (INTERFACE "eth0", ADDRESS dhcp) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NETWORK b AS (INTERFACE "eth0", ADDRESS "10.0.0.2/8") RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a gateway that is not an address is refused
rejects.source:
DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH x86_64, KERNEL linux) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CAPABILITY network AS (GRANT yes) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NETWORK lan AS (INTERFACE "eth0", ADDRESS "10.0.0.2/8", GATEWAY "router") RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: SLOTS needs a card and a firmware that can try a slot: the emulator boards load the kernel directly
rejects.source: DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH aarch64, KERNEL linux, BOARD qemu_virt, SLOTS "/dev/vda1") RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: SLOTS is a device path
rejects.source: DEFINE MACHINE m AS (PROFILE hosted, ARCH aarch64, KERNEL linux, BOARD rpi4, SLOTS "mmcblk0p1") RATIONALE "x"
